segments.text: Look at your to-do list today. Ten tasks. Now the uncomfortable truth: two of them are worth more than the other eight combined.
But the eight are easy, so that's what you do. Eight quick wins, eight lines crossed off, that little hit of done.
Meanwhile the two that actually matter just sit there. Same hours in your day, wildly different payoff.
That's the 80/20 rule. Before you touch the easy eight, ask: which two, done well, actually move my life? Do those first.
